_doc: Ashenreach, the forge city (the user's spec of 2026-11-07, docs/ashenreach.txt): its people and quests. 894 writes them into the brokenspire level's generator as townsfolk and quests of the town "Ashenreach" (FRDTownsfolkDef::Town, FRDQuestDef::Town): a role it has people for takes those in its posts (RDTownPlan.cpp's forge city), the others the shared ones. The functional ones: the guildmaster (the Elder's part: talk, quests), the master artificer (the Scholar's), the siege captain (the Captain's), the trades' keepers (their services). The quests count The War Engine's own counters ("war_engine:enter", ":tier", ":kills", ":boss").

townsfolk.name: AR_Guildmaster
townsfolk.title: Guildmaster Torvald Brask
townsfolk.calling: master of the Forge-Guild of Ashenreach
lines: Every blade from here to the coast was hammered in this city. Now our own foundry wants us dead.
Keep your voice down near the barricade. They listen.
topics: What happened to the foundry?|We built the War Engine to arm the whole realm: a forge that works itself, day and night. One night it stopped needing us. The hands who ran came out burned. The rest did not come out.
What is in there now?|Its machines. Iron hounds, walking anvils, things with our own tools for hands. And half of what is left of the men who worked there, bolted into the works.
How do I get in?|Through the barricade, across the casting hall, and through the iron gate in the furnace hall's far wall. The gate opens. That is the trouble.

townsfolk.name: AR_Artificer
townsfolk.title: Master Artificer Odile Fenn
townsfolk.calling: who drew the War Engine's plans
lines: I drew every gear of it. I did not draw what it is doing now.
Mind the soot. It gets into the lungs, and the ledgers.
topics: How deep does the factory go?|Five halls, each built below and behind the last as the guild grew greedy. The deepest was the Engine's heart. Nobody has walked it since the fires changed colour.
Can it be stopped?|Every machine has a governor. Its governors are its wardens now: the great machines on each floor. Break them, and the Engine slows.

townsfolk.name: AR_Captain
townsfolk.title: Captain Marek Dunholt
lines: Three weeks we have held this barricade. The machines have not tried it yet. That is what frightens me.
If you go in, go in quick and come out quicker.
topics: What comes out of the foundry?|Scouts, at night. Iron things that test the barricade and go back. They are counting us.
How do I help?|Thin them inside before they come out. And if you find what drives each hall, break it.

townsfolk.name: AR_Priest
townsfolk.title: Mother Ashwyn
townsfolk.calling: of the temple of the Ember
lines: The Ember gave us the forge. Pray it does not take it back.
A blessing costs little. Iron does not care whether you are blessed. You will.

townsfolk.name: AR_Smith
townsfolk.title: Hilde Ironhand
lines: Bring it here. Whatever they dented, I can beat straight.
Guild steel. The best there is, and the machines inside are made of it too. Think on that.

townsfolk.name: AR_Trader
townsfolk.title: Corvin Slagg
townsfolk.calling: who sells what the guild makes
lines: Blades, plate, potions, whetstones. The siege has been good for trade, gods forgive me.
Buy now. If the barricade falls, prices go up.

townsfolk.name: AR_Healer
townsfolk.title: Sister Calla
lines: Burns, mostly. And worse than burns, from the ones who came out.
Sit down before you fall down.

townsfolk.name: AR_Keeper
townsfolk.title: Bram the Weigher
lines: Weighed in, weighed out. What you leave with me is there when you come back.

townsfolk.name: AR_Innkeeper
townsfolk.title: Dagny Coalbrook
lines: Ale for the thirst, stew for the soot. Sit anywhere that is not on fire.
Half my regulars went into the foundry. The other half drink for them.

townsfolk.name: AR_Preacher
townsfolk.title: Brother Cinder
lines: We gave the fire a mind of iron. Now it wants a body of flesh!
Repent, Ashenreach! The furnaces are hungry and we fed them.

townsfolk.name: AR_Worker1
townsfolk.title: a forge hand
lines: Hammer, heat, hammer. The guild still pays by the blade, siege or no siege.
Mind the sparks.

townsfolk.name: AR_Worker2
townsfolk.title: an armourer's journeyman
lines: Every plate I rivet goes to the barricade. Every one.
My master went into the foundry to fetch his good tongs. Stupid man. Good tongs.

townsfolk.name: AR_Worker3
townsfolk.title: a gearwright
lines: I cut the Engine's teeth myself. Every gear. I wish I had cut them crooked.
If you hear ticking in there, run.

townsfolk.name: AR_Worker4
townsfolk.title: a smelter
lines: Ore in, iron out. That is all I ever wanted from a furnace.
The plain out there burned the year the Engine was lit. Coincidence, the guild says.

townsfolk.name: AR_Refugee1
townsfolk.title: a foundry hand
lines: I was on the night shift. The cranes started moving on their own. I did not wait to see where to.
My hands still shake. Look.

townsfolk.name: AR_Refugee2
townsfolk.title: a foundry hand
lines: They bolted Tomas into the press. He was still talking when I left. Still talking.
Do not go in there for the guild. Go in for the men inside, if any are left.

townsfolk.name: AR_Guard1
townsfolk.title: a guild sentry
lines: Welcome to Ashenreach. Wipe your boots. Everyone tracks soot in.
The foundry is in the middle. Follow the smoke.

townsfolk.name: AR_Guard2
townsfolk.title: a guild sentry
lines: Keep clear of the barricade unless you mean to go over it.

townsfolk.name: AR_Militia1
townsfolk.title: a guildsman on the walls
lines: We watch the plain. Nothing grows out there to hide behind. That is the one good thing about it.

townsfolk.name: AR_Militia2
townsfolk.title: a guildsman on the walls
lines: Ash on the wind again. Ash every day since the Engine was lit.

townsfolk.name: AR_Soldier1
townsfolk.title: a soldier of the siege
lines: Eyes on the door. Always on the door.
Something walked to the gate last night and stood there till dawn. Then it went back in.

townsfolk.name: AR_Soldier2
townsfolk.title: a soldier of the siege
lines: Aim for the joints. Iron has seams, same as bone.
Going in? Then I will hold the gap for you on the way out.

townsfolk.name: AR_Soldier3
townsfolk.title: a soldier of the siege
lines: Three weeks of watching a door. I would rather they came out.

townsfolk.name: AR_Child1
townsfolk.title: Pip Cokeley
lines: My da made the hounds' teeth. He says sorry every night.
Are the machines going to come out? Mam says no. Mam says no very fast.

townsfolk.name: AR_Child2
townsfolk.title: Wren
lines: Bring me back a gear! A big one!

townsfolk.name: AR_Mourner
townsfolk.title: Widow Hollis
lines: There is no body to bury. The foundry kept him.
The guild sent a coin. As if I could melt it down into a husband.

townsfolk.name: AR_Idiot
townsfolk.title: Tick-Tock Tam
lines: Tick, tock, tick, tock. It is counting. It is counting us!
The fire is thinking. Can you not hear it thinking?

townsfolk.name: AR_Citizen1
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Good day. If you can call it day under all this smoke.
We scrub the walls. The soot comes back by evening.

townsfolk.name: AR_Citizen2
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: My grandfather walked here when the plain was green. Hard to believe.

townsfolk.name: AR_Citizen3
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Another sword for hire. Good. The guild pays better than it prays.

quests.title: Through the Iron Gate
quests.offer: The gate in the furnace hall's far wall leads down into the works. Go in, see what the Engine has made of our foundry, and come back out to tell me. Out, mind.
quests.done: You came out. Nobody else has. Take this, and tell me everything.
quests.hint: Go through the iron gate in the Great Foundry's furnace hall

quests.title: Bank the Second Furnace
quests.offer: The second hall was the casting floor. If it is open again, the guild can think about taking it back. Open the way to the second hall.
quests.done: The casting floor. My father worked it. Thank you.
quests.hint: Open The War Engine's second hall

quests.title: The Heart of the Engine
quests.offer: The fourth hall is where the Engine's governors sit, and below it its heart. Reach the fourth hall, and the way down beyond it.
quests.done: Further than any of us dared. If the Engine has a heart, you have it in reach.
quests.hint: Open The War Engine's fourth hall

quests.title: Scrap Them
quests.offer: Every machine you break inside is one that will not test my barricade at night. Twenty-five of them.
quests.done: Twenty-five. The nights will be quieter. For a while.
quests.hint: Destroy machines inside The War Engine

quests.title: Break a Governor
quests.offer: The artificer says each hall has a governor: a great machine that drives the rest. Break one.
quests.done: One governor down. My soldiers will cheer, then they will sharpen their blades again.
quests.hint: Destroy a hall's governor in The War Engine

quests.title: The Guild's Ledger
quests.offer: The forge hands at the open forges remember what the Engine was fed in its last week. Ask one of them; I need to know what changed.
quests.done: Bone ash in the quench. Of course. It learned from what we fed it.
quests.hint: Speak to one of the forge hands

quests.title: Bounty: Iron Hounds
quests.offer: The armourers' hall pays for every iron hound brought down inside the foundry. Ten of them, twenty-five coins.
quests.done: The armourers pay, and ask for the scrap.
quests.hint: Destroy machines inside The War Engine
